Engineering objective and scope
Consolidate the reported isolated kernel, Asterisk policy parity, trusted recovery and executor-journal evidence, then obtain independent review and explicit scope acceptance. Preserve all four original reports.

Acceptance criteria and closure role
Independent reviewer records findings, scope and any required corrections in Git; authorized operator records acceptance of the isolated CP1 scope before Done. Developer tests do not satisfy either role. No production integration or GN-G3 transfer is included.
